scripts:
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/mysite
create path (nt:unstructured) /content/dam/mysite/jcr:content
set properties on /content/dam/mysite/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/mysite
  set jcr:title{String} to "My Site"
end

create path (sling:Folder) /content/dam/formsanddocuments
add mixin rep:AccessControllable to /content/dam/formsanddocuments
set ACL on /content/dam/formsanddocuments
  allow jcr:read for everyone
  allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:modifyAccessControl for fd-service
end
create path (sling:Folder) /content/dam/formsanddocuments-fdm
add mixin rep:AccessControllable to /content/dam/formsanddocuments-fdm
